name: Toy Town 3D
why: A toddler sing-along in real 3D: glossy toy characters, a rainbow bus and a candy-coloured town rendered in Blender, like the 3D nursery-rhyme channels.
look: Real 3D (Blender Cycles): soft sunlight, glossy plastic and soft-skin materials, big sparkly eyes, a cream bus with rainbow stripes on a bright toy-town road; words pop in as chunky 3D letters.
elements: a cream bus with rainbow stripes and a smiling grille
five round-faced characters (toddler, bunny, duckling, frog, bear)
motion: Everything bounces: springy pops on the word, gentle squash-and-stretch idles, hard cuts between shots.
